data.title: XCharge Reports First Half 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
data.description: On September 18, 2026, XCHG Limited, a leading global provider of high-power EV charging solutions, announced its unaudited financial results for the first half of 2026. The company, based in Hamburg, Germany and Austin, Texas, operates under the ticker symbol Nasdaq: XCH. The report covers the six-month period ending on June 30, 2026.

data.title: LOBO TECHNOLOGIES LTD. Announces First Half of Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results
data.description: In WUXI, China on September 18, 2026, LOBO TECHNOLOGIES LTD. (Nasdaq: LOBO), a leading electric mobility vehicles manufacturer, released its unaudited financial report for the initial half of fiscal year 2026 closing on June 30, 2026.

data.title: Phoenix Energy Announces Distribution for Preferred Shares
data.description: Phoenix Energy has declared a cash distribution of $0.625 per share for its Series A Preferred Shares. The payment will be made on October 15 to shareholders who are listed as of October 1.

data.title: Saratoga Investment Corp. Announces CFO Transition and New Leadership Appointments
data.description: New York, September 18, 2026 - Saratoga Investment Corp. (NYSE:SAR), a business development company, made public that Henri Steenkamp, the current Chief Financial Officer, Chief Compliance Officer, Treasurer, and Secretary, will be resigning from his roles for health reasons. The departure is set to be effective on October 31, 2026.

data.title: HF Foods Group Announces Termination of At-The-Market Equity Offering Program
data.description: HF Foods Group Inc., a prominent distributor of international foodservice solutions to Asian restaurants in the US and Canada, disclosed the termination of the Sales Agreement entered between the Company, D.A. Davidson & Co., and Roth Capital Partners, LLC on September 25, 2025. Additionally, the At-The-Market equity offering program, initiated on the same date, was also terminated. This program allowed the Company to vend shares of its common stock, targeting aggregate gross income of $100 million. The termination became effective on September 24, 2026.

data.title: Bloom Energy Honors Louisville First Responders During ESPN College Football Campus Tour
data.description: In San Jose, California, Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) is extending its partnership with ESPN Radio’s College Football Campus Tour by visiting Louisville, Kentucky this week. As part of the ongoing collaboration, Bloom Energy paid a visit to Engine 16 / Truck 3 in preparation for the Cardinals-SMU football game. In a show of support for the Louisville Fire Foundation, a nonprofit dedicated to aiding local firefighters and their families through various initiatives including training, fire safety education, and community programs, Bloom Energy made a contribution. The Louisville Fire Foundation provides assistance to firefighters and their families. The Engine 16 / Truck 3 station is situated close to the University of Louisville campus.

data.title: AM Best to Sponsor and Exhibit at ITC Vegas 2026
data.description: AM Best recently announced its participation as a bronze sponsor and exhibitor at InsureTech Connect Vegas 2026, happening at the Mandalay Bay Convention Center in Las Vegas from September 29 to October 1, 2026. At booth 1033, conference attendees will have the chance to learn more about AM Best and its offerings for insurance professionals. This includes BestESP, an electronic statement preparation tool that provides a user-friendly filing experience, and Best’s Insurance Reports, which elevate top-tier research capabilities. This event serves as a platform for showcasing AM Best's products and services to the industry, further emphasizing their commitment to empowering insurance professionals.
